name: paper-fetcher
description: Resolve DOIs, download PDFs (open access, publisher, or via the WUR library proxy in Chrome) with provenance, import browser downloads, search Zotero, extract PDF text.
long_description: Seven tools. resolve_doi: metadata and open-access status. fetch_pdf: open access first, then the publisher page, then (optional) the browser route. fetch_pdf_browser: opens a dedicated Chrome profile through the WUR EZproxy; the proxy session is saved and restored, the tool clicks the library 'Log in' button itself, and you only log in by hand when single sign-on asks for it. Slow browser downloads continue in the background (fetch_status). import_downloads: files PDFs from Downloads into the papers folder by DOI. zotero_lookup: read-only search of a copy of zotero.sqlite. pdf_to_text: text from a local PDF. Every download gets a <doi>.json provenance record.
